method: predicate relabeling within the intended cover's own incidence structure (prereg §5.1)

domain_structured.restriction: relabeling permutes predicates only within relational-domain blocks (primary MRC domain from the frozen registry)

dedup: canonical form = tuple over families (fixed order) of sorted predicate tuples; identity cover excluded; unique covers only
exhaustive_rule: if the unique non-identity population is <= n, enumerate exhaustively and record the size
p_value: (1 + #{null >= observed}) / (n + 1), n = null count actually used

synthesis_subset.rule: first 100 covers in seeded sample order; for an exhaustive population, random.Random(seed).sample(range(N), 100)

implementation: src/wrm_e2/nulls.py (hash recorded at the freeze act)
